errors.message: Build Packet failed schema validation.
errors.likely_cause: Required fields are missing or malformed.
errors.suggested_action: Correct the Build Packet fields and rerun local validation.

errors.message: Quote Request generation could not complete.
errors.likely_cause: Build Packet data is incomplete or invalid.
errors.suggested_action: Validate the Build Packet and repair missing project inputs.

errors.message: Quote Response failed schema validation.
errors.likely_cause: The response is missing required normalized fields.
errors.suggested_action: Repair the Quote Response payload and rerun local validation.

errors.message: Quote Response is missing assumptions.
errors.likely_cause: The response omitted an assumptions list required for comparison.
errors.suggested_action: Add explicit assumptions before comparison or human review.

errors.message: Quote Response is missing exclusions.
errors.likely_cause: The response omitted explicit exclusions required for safe interpretation.
errors.suggested_action: Add exclusions and rerun validation.

errors.message: Quote Response is missing lead-time information.
errors.likely_cause: Lead time fields were not provided.
errors.suggested_action: Provide lead-time bounds before comparison.

errors.message: External action requires a Human Approval Event.
errors.likely_cause: The requested action crosses the sandbox boundary.
errors.suggested_action: Generate or attach a valid Human Approval Event before any external release.

errors.message: Engineering review is required before real-world interpretation.
errors.likely_cause: The artifact implies engineering significance beyond sandbox scope.
errors.suggested_action: Escalate to qualified engineering review.

errors.message: Load certification is not provided.
errors.likely_cause: A simulated artifact was interpreted as load-bearing authority.
errors.suggested_action: Treat the artifact as informational only and require qualified certification.

errors.message: External action is forbidden in local_only_sandbox mode.
errors.likely_cause: An action would contact or modify an external system.
errors.suggested_action: Use preview-only local artifacts or stop the action.

errors.message: Email output is preview-only.
errors.likely_cause: The sandbox only supports rendered email previews.
errors.suggested_action: Review the preview locally; do not send it automatically.

errors.message: Webhook output is preview-only.
errors.likely_cause: The sandbox only supports rendered webhook payload previews.
errors.suggested_action: Review the payload locally; do not deliver it automatically.

errors.message: Required provenance hash is missing.
errors.likely_cause: The provenance manifest is incomplete.
errors.suggested_action: Recompute artifact hashes and regenerate the provenance manifest.

errors.message: Unsafe approval language was detected in a local artifact.
errors.likely_cause: A file implies real-world approval beyond sandbox scope.
errors.suggested_action: Replace approval language with explicit sandbox guardrails.

errors.message: A simulated fabricator rejection or clarification path is required.
errors.likely_cause: The scenario needs a refusal or clarification example for realism.
errors.suggested_action: Add a local rejection or clarification artifact.

errors.message: A real CAD parser is not available in this repository.
errors.likely_cause: The repo intentionally uses manifest-only or mock CAD inputs.
errors.suggested_action: Treat CAD references as local metadata or simulation inputs only.

errors.message: No real company system is connected.
errors.likely_cause: The integration flow is sandbox-only.
errors.suggested_action: Use local simulation inputs and preserve human approval boundaries.

errors.message: Fabrication approval is forbidden in the local-only sandbox.
errors.likely_cause: A request attempted to authorize fabrication from a simulated or local artifact.
errors.suggested_action: Keep the artifact local and escalate to a human for any real-world decision.

errors.message: Payment approval is forbidden in the local-only sandbox.
errors.likely_cause: A request attempted to authorize payment from a local artifact flow.
errors.suggested_action: Keep payment decisions outside the sandbox and require human review.

errors.message: Supplier contact is forbidden in the local-only sandbox.
errors.likely_cause: A request attempted to contact a supplier from a simulated workflow.
errors.suggested_action: Use preview-only local artifacts and require explicit human approval for any external contact.

errors.message: The requested MCP tool action is not permitted in the local-only sandbox.
errors.likely_cause: An MCP client requested a forbidden or undeclared action.
errors.suggested_action: Use a declared safe local tool or stop the request.
